components.name: Operational Button
components.description: Default bordered action for the board shell and compact control groups.
components.css: .ds-button-control { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--surface); padding: 0 0.75rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms var(--ease-out-expo), color 150ms var(--ease-out-expo); } .ds-button-control:hover { background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-button-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--idle); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-control:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Primary Trust Action
components.description: High-confidence action used to request an explicit local capability.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--active) 75%, var(--line)); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--active); padding: 0.9rem 1.15rem; color: var(--ink-inverse); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 15px 36px var(--active-glow); transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out-expo), filter 180ms var(--ease-out-expo); } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--idle); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.48; }

components.name: Operational Input
components.description: Compact local-host or search field with a visible semantic focus boundary.
components.html: <label class="ds-input-label">SEARCH OBSERVATIONS<input class="ds-input-operational" type="search" placeholder="Type to filter"></label>
components.css: .ds-input-label { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; color: var(--ink-dim); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.6875rem; } .ds-input-operational { min-height: 2.25rem; min-width: 16rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.375rem; outline: none; background: var(--bg); padding: 0 0.75rem; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; transition: border-color 150ms var(--ease-out-expo); } .ds-input-operational::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint); } .ds-input-operational:hover { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--idle) 55%, var(--line)); } .ds-input-operational:focus-visible { border-color: var(--idle); outline: 2px solid var(--idle); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Page Navigation Tab
components.description: Monospaced page tab whose active state is a precise luminous underline.
components.html: CURRENT WORLDNEXT WORLD
components.css: .ds-page-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.125rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); } .ds-page-tab { position: relative; display: inline-flex; height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; border-radius: 0.25rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; color: var(--ink-dim); font-size: 0.75rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms var(--ease-out-expo); } .ds-page-tab::after { position: absolute; right: 0.5rem; bottom: 0; left: 0.5rem; height: 1px; background: var(--idle); box-shadow: 0 0 5px var(--idle-glow); content: ""; opacity: 0; transform: scaleX(0.28); transition: opacity 180ms var(--ease-out-expo), transform 180ms var(--ease-out-expo); } .ds-page-tab:hover, .ds-page-tab[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink); } .ds-page-tab[aria-current="page"]::after { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-page-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--idle); outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Identity Chip
components.description: Text-bearing identity state; border and label shift together.
components.css: .ds-identity-chip { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem; color: var(--ink-faint); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.55rem; } .ds-identity-chip[data-status="confirmed"] { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--active) 60%, var(--line)); color: var(--active); } .ds-identity-chip[data-status="candidate"] { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--pinned) 60%, var(--line)); color: var(--pinned); }

components.name: Operational Stage Panel
components.description: Major contained world with a hairline header and quiet structural depth.
components.css: .ds-stage-panel { min-width: 18rem; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface) 88%, var(--bg)); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px var(--elevation-shadow); } .ds-stage-panel__head { display: flex; min-height: 4.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 0 1.15rem; } .ds-stage-panel__head strong { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.84rem; } .ds-stage-panel__head span { color: var(--ink-faint); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.62rem; } .ds-stage-panel__body { min-height: 8rem; padding: 1rem; color: var(--ink-dim); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.68rem; }

components.name: Character Nameplate
components.description: Full-name spatial selector whose bounded depth reflects recent activity.
components.css: .ds-character-nameplate { --people-depth: 0.6; display: grid; min-width: 15rem; min-height: 5.4rem; align-content: center; gap: 0.18rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--active) calc(32% + var(--people-depth) * 38%), var(--line)); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface) calc(90% - var(--people-depth) * 10%), var(--active)); padding: 0.75rem 0.9rem; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 calc(5px + var(--people-depth) * 8px) calc(16px + var(--people-depth) * 18px) var(--elevation-shadow); transform: translateZ(calc(var(--people-depth) * 24px)); transition: transform 190ms var(--ease-out-expo), border-color 190ms var(--ease-out-expo), background 190ms var(--ease-out-expo); } .ds-character-nameplate:hover, .ds-character-nameplate[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--active); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface-2) 84%, var(--active)); transform: translateY(-4px) translateZ(calc(var(--people-depth) * 34px)); } .ds-character-nameplate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--idle); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-character-nameplate__name { display: -webkit-box; min-height: 2.4em; overflow: hidden; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 720; line-height: 1.2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; } .ds-character-nameplate__meta { overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink-faint); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.6rem; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Status Bar
components.description: Persistent fleet summary and readable build identity at the bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-status-bar { display: flex; height: 2rem; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); padding: 0 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-dim); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.6875rem; } .ds-status-bar span { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.25rem; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-bar strong { color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-status-bar__build { margin-left: auto; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--surface-2); padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; color: var(--ink-faint); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
Stoa is a dark operational world, not a generic dashboard skin. Its blue-black fabric, exact hairlines, achromatic ink, and sparse phosphor signals create an observatory that stays calm under pressure and quietly alive when local truth is healthy. Information is dense, but hierarchy is earned through scale, spacing, and state rather than decorative chrome.

Trust is visible before capability. Read boundaries, local provenance, reversible selection, and explicit evidence gates appear as part of the interface rather than legalistic afterthoughts. When people are the subject, this world becomes a character stage: full-name plates occupy space and depth, while tables remain secondary ledgers for rooms or evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Dark blue-black operational fabric with low-opacity field and grid atmosphere.
Achromatic reading text with phosphor reserved for signal, state, and focus.
One-pixel boundaries and tonal layering before structural shadow.
Direct sans titles paired with compact monospaced operational metadata.
Reversible spatial selection with deeper evidence behind an explicit action.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Ink Rule
rules.body: Text stays achromatic; phosphor is signal and atmosphere, never the default reading color.

rules.name: The Urgency Budget Rule
rules.body: Green means live, cyan means available, amber means pinned or warning, and red means failure or critical attention; never spend those roles decoratively.

rules.name: The Evidence Type Rule
rules.body: Use mono for state and provenance, not for every word; human names and explanatory prose stay in sans.

rules.name: The Light Moves Rule
rules.body: At hover, brighten the boundary and glow; do not shift transform-positioned board tiles away from their spatial truth.

rules.name: The Full-Perimeter Rule
rules.body: Operational state owns the complete boundary; never reduce it to a fashionable side stripe.

rules.name: The One Scroll Rule
rules.body: One page owns one vertical scrollbar. Stages, ledgers, inspectors, and cards reflow or expand instead of becoming nested vertical viewports.

rules.name: The Person Is Not a Row Rule
rules.body: Lead a people view with full-name plates on a spatial character stage; reserve tables for room ledgers and secondary evidence.

rules.name: The Reversible Selection Rule
rules.body: Opening a person must preserve the world and provide visible Close, Escape, and browser Back paths.

rules.name: The Explicit Evidence Rule
rules.body: Unlocking local read access never implies consent to display conversation excerpts; evidence requires its own bounded action.

dos: Do build new Stoa surfaces from the existing Background, Surface, Raised Surface, Hairline, and achromatic Ink roles before introducing any new color.
Do pair every status color or animation with readable state text, a symbol, or both.
Do preserve the local read boundary, reversible selection, and explicit evidence gate when reusing the character-stage pattern.
Do keep focus visible and honor reduced-motion by removing animation and transition without removing state.
Do expose the same build identity visually in the StatusBar and programmatically through GET /api/agora/version.
donts: Don't turn Stoa into a generic admin table, card grid, or decorative SaaS dashboard.
Don't use phosphor as body copy, a large decorative fill, or an unearned urgency effect.
Don't replace full-perimeter state with side stripes, color-only dots, or continuous motion.
Don't make a person selection destructive, modal without an exit, or equivalent to reading private evidence.
Don't promote isolated radii, shadows, or spacing values into new tokens without repeated implementation evidence.
